chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which he would rouse his companions to jihad against the people of Syria in his time.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali mobilize his followers for the campaign against Syria?
ai.summary: This sermon, delivered during the Battle of Siffin, exemplifies Imam Ali’s strategic use of rhetoric to unify his diverse army against the Umayyad forces of Muawiya. It highlights the Shia perspective on 'jihād al-akbar' in governance, where political legitimacy and military action are intertwined to uphold the divine right of the Ahl al-Bayt. The context underscores the internal strife (fitna) that characterized the early Islamic period, framing the conflict not merely as a territorial dispute but as a struggle for justice against usurpation.
